Settings is live at **http://maker:4001** (refresh) — click **⚙ Settings** in the top bar. Please confirm the last pieces:

1. **Display preferences.** In Settings → *Display*: change **Default sort** (it updates and is remembered), set **Show per page** to a small number like 10 (the list then shows a **"Show N more"** control for the rest), and switch **Text size** to Large/Small to see the collection scale. All three stick across visits.
2. **Data tools moved here.** Settings → *Data* now holds **Import** and **Export** (no longer cluttering the header). Export includes archived bookmarks in an **"Archived" folder**; importing that file back restores their archived status, and already-saved links are skipped.

If those match, here's the honest status: **every management and preservation area from your list is now explored and settled** — editing/deleting/opening, archive vs delete, multi-select (incl. "all matching"), formatted notes, preserved copies + Internet Archive + PDF handling, saved filters with include/exclude, import/export, and display preferences. That's **18 settled behaviours** in total, plus the earlier saving/finding foundation.

Recorded for later cycles (not this build): a native mobile experience, and automatic preservation.

One honesty note for when we build: the prototype **simulates** real page-capture and the actual Internet Archive submission; those get built for real in implementation, along with genuine per-account storage of your collection and preferences.

**With all of that settled — may I now switch from exploring to building this as the real application?** I won't start until you say yes.
